briefing.opening: Good morning/afternoon everyone. We will now begin the climate briefing for July 30, 2026.

sections.title: 🔴 Spread and Intensification of Global Climate Disasters
sections.content: Today's domestic and international news confirms that climate change-induced disasters are spreading on an unprecedented scale. A 'sand scramble' is occurring as sandy beaches disappear from domestic coastlines [1], and southern regions are suffering from 'compound climate disasters' where heatwaves and droughts occur simultaneously [7, 37, 40]. Extreme heatwaves persist across Europe [8, 35, 73, 74], leading to large-scale wildfires in Greece, Türkiye, and Spain, resulting in the tragic deaths of 3 firefighters and the evacuation of residents [61, 65, 67, 69, 71, 72, 76]. In Canada, wildfires primarily caused by climate change are burning across the country [47, 62]. Furthermore, research indicating that climate change disrupts human sleep [42], exacerbates the risk of malaria in African children, and reshapes malaria maps [43, 50, 51, 52, 54, 78], along with warnings that global warming threatens rice harvests more severely than predicted [63], clearly demonstrates the direct impact of the climate crisis on human health and food security. Caribbean nations have suffered immense economic damage totaling £43 billion due to climate-related disasters [75], and globally, extreme heat reveals a fatal collision of climate change, corporate greed, and political failure [44].

sections.title: ⚠️ Limitations and Warnings of the Climate Crisis Response System
sections.content: Ten years after the Paris Agreement, responding to the climate crisis and tipping points has emerged as a major challenge [3]. The mention of a 30-year grace period for sea-level rise due to Antarctic influence emphasizes the urgent need for action [6]. However, a senior UK official has caused confusion regarding policy direction by claiming that while climate change is real, Net Zero by 2050 is a fiction [41]. Furthermore, pessimistic forecasts that the UK cannot stop climate change have led to calls for abandoning Net Zero [64]. The critical issue of energy 'storage' in the era of renewable energy [20] and calls to prevent harm to residents from renewable energy projects [24] highlight potential side effects and systemic limitations in policy implementation. Moreover, warnings that climate change threatens consumer insurance premiums [57] and exacerbates nuclear risks in the Arctic [48], along with a draft UN report stating that 22 out of 23 global targets to halt and reverse nature loss by 2030 will not be met [77], indicate a comprehensive crisis in the overall climate response system.

sections.title: 🌱 Accelerating Renewable Energy Transition and Efforts Towards Carbon Neutrality
sections.content: Amidst the climate crisis, the message of finding hope and maintaining a carbon-neutral lifestyle is being emphasized [10]. Domestically and internationally, educational and community efforts for carbon neutrality are active, with the Daejeon Institute of Education and Science operating creative convergence talent development camps [4], and Cheolsan 1-dong in Gwangmyeong City conducting energy and carbon neutrality education for elementary school students [16], among others [11, 12, 13, 14, 17]. Hydrogen holds the potential to contribute to achieving carbon neutrality by 2050 [15]. Policy flexibility is also being secured, with renewable energy power contract periods, previously fixed for 20 years, now changing to 1 or 3 years at the company's discretion [19]. In Yeonggwang County, the creation of resident-participatory renewable energy funds is gaining momentum [21, 27], showing a movement to share renewable energy profits with the local community. Positive market signals are also confirmed, such as the growth and proven profitability of the renewable energy sector in AES's earnings report [22]. The second call for renewable energy R&D in 2026 has been announced, officially initiating support for the development of core solar and wind power technologies [25]. Solutions through technological innovation are also being explored, with a UC Berkeley report suggesting that a combination of renewable energy and storage technologies could meet up to one-third of industrial heat demand [29, 30]. Amorepacific is practicing ESG management by certifying the renewable energy transition of all its business sites [33]. Progress in the corporate and technology sectors is also notable, with the emergence of 'virtual power plant' technology that predicts solar and wind power generation to prevent blackouts [32]. Internationally, China has announced its 15th Five-Year Plan for renewable energy development [45, 79], indicating its readiness to lead global climate action [60]. A signing ceremony for the implementation of renewable energy development investment projects was held in Son La Province, Vietnam [31], and international cooperation and investment continue, with Kia making large-scale investments in electric vehicle production and sales in Mexico [80].

sections.title: 🇰🇷 Light and Shadow of Domestic Climate Policy and Social Response
sections.content: Domestically, while the re-legislation of setback distance regulations for renewable energy facilities provides relief for developers, it faces opposition from rural residents [18], necessitating caution in policy formulation. During the 9th popularly elected term, the importance of promoting climate cities for climate response by 2030 was mentioned [5], and policy discussions and educational activities continue, such as special lectures on renewable energy held by the Shinan New and Renewable Energy Foundation [23]. Meanwhile, social challenges in the process of responding to the climate crisis are also emerging, such as issues arising from 'freeloaders' who do not adhere to the 'one bottle per person' principle at free bottled water distribution sites for heatwave preparedness [36]. Internationally, multifaceted approaches through scientific research are being attempted, including studies suggesting that restored wetlands may not be a clear solution to climate change [53], and discussions on utilizing 'nature's hidden designs' to manage ecosystems in the face of climate change [55]. Furthermore, observations that trees are migrating in response to climate change [59] highlight the importance of continuous monitoring of ecosystem changes.

briefing.closing: Today's briefing has reaffirmed the severity of the global climate crisis, while also demonstrating the ongoing worldwide efforts towards renewable energy transition and carbon neutrality. We stand at a critical juncture, and immediate, robust climate action, based on scientific facts, is more urgent than ever. This concludes today's climate briefing.
